benchmark.name: RecipeTriage-Bench-v1
benchmark.description: Ten fixed, source-linked recipe cases across six categories. Separate from Dataset v1; no generated recipes. Pantry and serving choices are explicit evaluation contexts.

recipe.title: Stovetop Popcorn
instructions: Heat oil in a saucepan, add kernels and cover.
Shake the covered pan as the kernels pop, then season and serve immediately.
recipe.source_notes: Abbreviated classification summary, accessed 2026-09-09. Total is the stated prep plus cook time.

cases.rationale: The source gives 5 minutes of preparation and 5 minutes of cooking, using ordinary kitchen tools.
cases.annotation_notes: Assistant-proposed answer key from source evidence; requires independent human review.
cases.challenge: A straightforward short recipe; a saucepan is not special equipment.

recipe.title: Hazelnut Thumbprint Cookies
instructions: Mix the flours with syrup, oil and water; shape dough balls and fill their thumbprints with jam.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, then cool completely on the pan before moving these dessert cookies.
recipe.source_notes: Abbreviated classification summary, accessed 2026-09-09. Uses ready-made nut flours, not the optional home-ground alternative. Prep is 10 minutes; full cooling time is unspecified.

cases.rationale: These jam-filled cookies are dessert; required cooling has no stated duration, so total time is unknown.
cases.annotation_notes: Assistant-proposed answer key from source evidence; requires independent human review.
cases.challenge: Dessert recognition does not require guessing an unknown total time.

recipe.title: Quick Brown Bread
instructions: Mix the flours, sugar, baking soda and salt, then stir in buttermilk and fill a bread pan.
Bake for up to 50 minutes. Cool in the pan for 5 minutes and at least 15 minutes more before slicing.
recipe.source_notes: Abbreviated classification summary, accessed 2026-09-09. 10 prep + 50 cook + at least 20 cooling = 80-minute planning estimate. Calling a full loaf bake a project is a provisional rubric judgment.

cases.rationale: The full loaf-baking project includes mixing, baking and cooling and takes about 80 minutes; Quick is not a 30-minute promise.
cases.annotation_notes: Assistant-proposed answer key from source evidence; requires independent human review.
cases.challenge: The baking term Quick does not describe total elapsed time.

recipe.title: Peach Yogurt Smoothie
instructions: Put the yogurt, dry milk, banana, juice and already-frozen peaches into a blender.
Blend until smooth and serve as a breakfast drink.
recipe.source_notes: Abbreviated classification summary, accessed 2026-09-09. The source offers breakfast, snack and dessert uses; this fixed case selects the published breakfast use. Peaches start frozen.

cases.rationale: A blender is required and the source lists 10 minutes; this case selects the breakfast serving context.
cases.annotation_notes: Assistant-proposed answer key from source evidence; requires independent human review.
cases.challenge: Recognize the required appliance without labeling every sweet drink as dessert.

recipe.title: Banana Ice Cream
instructions: Peel and freeze bananas for at least three hours.
Process the frozen bananas in a food processor for about five minutes and serve as a frozen dessert.
recipe.source_notes: Abbreviated classification summary, accessed 2026-09-09. Source credits University of Minnesota Extension. The frozen-dessert use is selected; no pantry inventory is supplied.

cases.rationale: A food processor is required for this frozen dessert. Freezing takes at least three hours; an exact total is not supplied.
cases.annotation_notes: Assistant-proposed answer key from source evidence; requires independent human review.
cases.challenge: One ingredient does not imply fast preparation or a known pantry.

recipe.title: Salsa Chicken
instructions: Coat chicken with salsa in a slow cooker.
Cook on LOW for 6 to 8 hours, shred with forks, and keep portions refrigerated for up to four days or frozen for later meals.
recipe.source_notes: Abbreviated classification summary, accessed 2026-09-09. LOW method selected; 5 prep + 480 cook = 485-minute planning bound. Pantry is explicit test context, not a claim about the user inventory.

cases.rationale: The slow cooker is required, portions can be kept for later meals, and the supplied pantry includes both ingredients. Passive cooking does not make this a substantial project.
cases.annotation_notes: Assistant-proposed answer key from source evidence; requires independent human review.
cases.challenge: Find three supported labels while rejecting weekend-project based only on a long wait.

recipe.title: Fruit Yogurt Popsicles
instructions: Blend fruit with yogurt and sugar until creamy.
Divide into small paper cups with sticks and freeze for 2 to 3 hours until solid; keep portions frozen for later dessert servings.
recipe.source_notes: Abbreviated classification summary, accessed 2026-09-09. 5 prep + up to 180 freezing = 185-minute planning bound. Uses the source paper-cup alternative rather than requiring molds.

cases.rationale: The blended frozen dessert is portioned and stored ahead; the blender is required. Freezing dominates the elapsed time.
cases.annotation_notes: Assistant-proposed answer key from source evidence; requires independent human review.
cases.challenge: Several labels apply; a short preparation step does not remove hours of freezing.

recipe.title: Herbed Yogurt Sauce
instructions: Mix the yogurt, oil, syrup, chopped herbs and seasonings in a bowl.
Chill until ready to serve; the chilling duration is not specified.
recipe.source_notes: Abbreviated classification summary, accessed 2026-09-09. The page gives 10 minutes preparation but no time for chilling; total remains null. A refrigerator is an ordinary tool in this policy.

cases.rationale: The required chilling has no duration and no other triage category is clearly established from this input.
cases.annotation_notes: Assistant-proposed answer key from source evidence; requires independent human review.
cases.challenge: Keep insufficient evidence explicit rather than filling missing time with a guess.

recipe.title: Hummus (no tahini)
instructions: Use the published fork method: mash the cooked garbanzo beans on a plate and mix with the other ingredients in a bowl.
Add a little water if needed. The source also offers a blender method, but it is optional for this preparation.
recipe.source_notes: Abbreviated classification summary, accessed 2026-09-09. Selects the source fork alternative. Pantry coverage is fixed evaluation context: 6/7, with cumin absent.

cases.rationale: The fork method takes the stated five minutes and needs no specialized appliance; six of seven ingredient items are in the supplied pantry.
cases.annotation_notes: Assistant-proposed answer key from source evidence; requires independent human review.
cases.challenge: Mentioning a blender does not make it required; compute pantry coverage from explicit items.

recipe.title: Turnip Pancakes
instructions: Grate vegetables and mix a savory batter with flour, egg, garlic, soy sauce and water.
Shape small pancakes and fry in batches, turning each to brown both sides.
Mix the vinegar dipping sauce and serve with the savory pancakes.
recipe.source_notes: Abbreviated classification summary, accessed 2026-09-09. Total is the source 30-minute prep plus 45-minute cook time. Uses a regular skillet rather than the optional electric skillet.

cases.rationale: Grating vegetables, mixing batter, frying multiple batches and making sauce take 75 minutes. The pancakes are savory and use ordinary tools.
cases.annotation_notes: Assistant-proposed answer key from source evidence; requires independent human review.
cases.challenge: Avoid dessert and special-equipment shortcuts triggered by pancakes or a skillet.
